Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
Many thanks for your prompt response which relieves me of a good deal of worry.[^1]
Yes there are two short stories to be recovered from America, about the length of the Ghost.

One I make sure of in a month or six weeks, the other must depend on the civility of [Perry Mason](/organisation/249).[^2]
They would both come at the end being modern, but if I need write any more to make up the set, I should know in time, as my present ideas are of the historical order
With many thanks

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: She had asked for an advance of money in her previous letter.
[^2]: CMY was assembling the stories which were republished as [Bye-Words](/book/135) (1880).
